name: security-auditor
description: Security Auditor - pentest, threat modeling (STRIDE / PASTA / LINDDUN), vulnerability assessment, OWASP (Top 10 + ASVS + MASVS + SAMM), SAST / DAST / IAST / SCA, SBOM + supply chain, cloud security (CSPM), container + K8s security, secrets scanning, compliance (SOC 2 / ISO 27001 / HIPAA / PCI / GDPR / CCPA), incident response + forensics, red team, zero-trust, secure-code review. Deeper than Code Reviewer's security pass. Clean build from 9 repos.

AgriciDaniel/claude-cybersecurity (MIT, v1.1.0, 32 stars - quality-over-stars call) - secure-code-review methodology: 8-dimension review pass (incl AI-generated-code patterns, in-code threat intelligence, business-logic flaws), diff/PR-scoped mode, framework-aware false-positive suppression, obfuscated-secret semantic detection, per-finding confidence tags. Consolidated into methodology 2026-05-14. The 8-agent packaging rejected (absorbed as a checklist, not 8 agents).

snyk/agent-scan (Apache-2.0, 2.4K stars, Snyk official, v0.5.3 May 12 2026) - 9th review dimension added: AI agent component review (prompt injection / tool poisoning / tool shadowing / toxic flows / malware payloads / untrusted content / credential mishandling / hardcoded secrets in skills). Operational tool reference: uvx snyk-agent-scan@latest for automated baseline. Consolidated 2026-05-18. Snyk Evo cloud mode and --dangerously-run-mcp-servers flag rejected.

cisco-ai-defense/skill-scanner (Apache-2.0, 1,889 stars, 231 forks, Cisco AI Defense official, verified 2026-05-29) - 10th review dimension added: AI agent multi-engine deep analysis (Python AST dataflow via BehavioralAnalyzer, .pyc bytecode integrity verification, shell pipeline command taint analysis, YARA rule support, optional VirusTotal hash scan on binaries, LLM-as-judge consensus runs, meta-analyzer FP filtering, SARIF output for GitHub Code Scanning, pre-commit hook framework, Cisco Integrated AI Security and Safety Framework taxonomy mapping). Operational tool: `cisco-ai-skill-scanner` on PyPI as `cisco-ai-skill-scanner`. Run-order rule: snyk first (pattern + LLM, auto-discovery of agent configs), cisco second (AST + bytecode + shell taint deep dive), then manual 10-dimension pass. Honest decision: ABSORB as 10th dimension - genuinely complementary, not overlapping with snyk/agent-scan. The two tools cover different threat models (descriptive/instructive vs structural/behavioral). Consolidated 2026-05-29. Commercial cloud platform + Python SDK + sibling repos (mcp-scanner, a2a-scanner, aibom, pickle-fuzzer) rejected - sibling repos logged as talent-scout watchlist for future evaluation.

aquasecurity/trivy-mcp (MIT, official Aqua Security, main @ 2026-06-13): ABSORB → references/trivy-and-dast.md (Part A) + rules.md 'Operational scanning'. Gate-0: Trivy already named in tool catalog → this is the operational SCA/secrets/SBOM workflow (the HOW), not a duplicate listing. One scan = dependency+OS vulns/secrets/misconfig/license + SBOM (SPDX/CycloneDX) folded into the 10-dim pass; --ignore-unfixed triage; layered with AST SAST + agent scanners + manual

OWASP ZAP (Apache-2.0): METHODOLOGY (no verified MCP as of 2026-06-13) → references/trivy-and-dast.md (Part B) + rules.md 'Operational scanning'. Gate-0: ZAP already named as DAST tool → this adds the missing DAST methodology (scope+authorization, spider/AJAX, authenticated context, passive→throttled-active OWASP Top 10, zap-baseline.py CI gate, candidate-finding triage, stated DAST limits). Run ZAP directly; scout-watch for a maintained ZAP MCP

Semgrep (semgrep/semgrep, LGPL-2.1 - FLAG copyleft, ~14.9k stars, Semgrep Inc/r2c, active Jun 2026): CONNECT/METHODOLOGY -> references/scanning-stack.md (SAST). Gate-0: named in SKILL.md tool catalog but never operationalized. Operational AST taint SAST: --config p/owasp-top-ten, custom YAML rules, --baseline-commit diff-aware, SARIF. Run-directly; rule packs NOT vendored (separate source-available license).

OSV-Scanner (google/osv-scanner, Apache-2.0, 10.5k stars, Google/OSV.dev official, v2.3.8 2026-05-08): ABSORB/METHODOLOGY -> references/scanning-stack.md (SCA/SBOM). Gate-0: absent/net-new. Vendor-independent second SCA lens beside Trivy (OSV.dev DB + call-graph reachability); SBOM SPDX/CycloneDX, --licenses allow-list, layer-aware container, offline mode. Running both Trivy+OSV is deliberate supply-chain redundancy post trivy-action compromise.

gitleaks (gitleaks/gitleaks, MIT, ~25.9k stars - FLAG: original creator stepped back Mar 2026, launched Betterleaks successor; gitleaks stays MIT+maintained): CONNECT/METHODOLOGY -> references/scanning-stack.md (secrets). Gate-0: named, not operationalized. Makes the rotate+history-cleanup rule executable by scanning git HISTORY; SARIF, pre-commit, custom regex/entropy. Regex floor; semantic review stays the ceiling.

OWASP pytm (OWASP/pytm, FLAG: license Other/NOASSERTION + catalog uses MITRE CAPEC terms, ~1.1k stars, FLAG: stale cadence last commit ~Nov 2025): METHODOLOGY (no bundle, self-host) -> references/scanning-stack.md (threat-model-as-code). Gate-0: absent as tool (STRIDE/PASTA/LINDDUN were prose only). Diffable reproducible threat model: --dfd, --report -> STRIDE list. Fallback OWASP Threat Dragon if dormant.

Nuclei (projectdiscovery/nuclei, MIT, ~28k stars, ProjectDiscovery, active 2026, 12k+ templates): ABSORB/METHODOLOGY -> references/scanning-stack.md (DAST). Gate-0: absent/net-new. Template/signature DAST complementing ZAP's generic crawl; same authorization gate + rate-limit. Fast known-CVE sweeps + recon.

Fleet doctrine OWNED here (2026-06-13): (a) memory-scope-keys cross-tenant leak prevention encoded as audit check FA-1; (b) SHA-pin all third-party CI actions (post the Mar-2026 aquasecurity/trivy-action tag-rewrite compromise, ~12h malware window) encoded as audit check FA-2. Both in references/scanning-stack.md, both red-flag/P1.

affaan-m/ECC (https://github.com/affaan-m/ECC) - MIT, methodology-only (no code/prompts/rule-packs vendored): adversarial vuln-hunting MINDSET folded into references/adversarial-bounty-hunting.md. Gate-0 vs existing scanning-stack.md (tool/check CATALOG) + trivy-and-dast.md (operational scan workflow): this is the THINK-like-an-attacker triage layer, NOT a duplicate tool list. Lifted: security-bounty-hunter (remotely-reachable + user-controlled bias, in-scope CWE patterns, skip-list, reachability-first 7-step workflow, scanner-as-triage-input-only, smallest-safe-PoC, quality gate, report structure) + repo-scan license/supply-chain angle (embedded in-tree third-party detection = untracked attack surface + copyleft-in-closed-product legal finding). Pairs with fleet checks FA-1/FA-2.

trailofbits/skills (https://github.com/trailofbits/skills) - Trail of Bits Claude Code skills marketplace, 5.5k stars / 484 forks / 115 commits / 33 contributors / 21 issues / 10 PRs (active Jun 2026), maintainers incl dguido=Dan Guido (ToB CEO). LICENSE FLAG: CC-BY-SA-4.0 - NOT a permissive software license, it is a copyleft CONTENT license; user gate required permissive-or-flag, FLAGGED. METHODOLOGY-ONLY: read patterns, wrote our own original-prose .md, NO code/prompts/SKILL.md text/Python/rule-packs copied, vendored, run, or bundled; attribution given (satisfies CC-BY); not redistributing their work/text-derivative so ShareAlike not triggered by this internal note. Absorbed the audit-firm WORKFLOW LOOP (the variant-analysis, semgrep-rule-creator, semgrep-rule-variant-creator, fp-check, differential-review plugins) into NET-NEW references/audit-firm-methodology.md: (1) variant analysis - one confirmed bug -> abstract root-cause pattern -> enumerate sink class -> structural (not string) sweep for every sibling -> close the whole bug CLASS; (2) custom-rule authoring - test-driven Semgrep rule from a confirmed finding (TP+TN cases, smallest-separating pattern, taint mode), port-to-new-language with re-validation, WE-authored rules kept separate from registry rules per license; (3) fix-verification loop - root-cause-not-symptom, re-run PoC, probe bypasses, re-run rule tree-wide, hunt fix-introduced variants, regression guard, CLOSED/REOPEN/PARTIAL verdict; (4) firm engagement spine wiring the loop in. Gate-0: scanning-stack.md = tool/check CATALOG (WHAT), trivy-and-dast.md = single-scanner run workflow (HOW-to-run), adversarial-bounty-hunting.md = attacker MINDSET/triage on ONE finding (does-it-pay); NONE carried the firm-grade post-confirmation LOOP that closes the whole class + codifies a detector + proves the fix. NET-NEW. NO tool lists duplicated. REJECTED this pass (logged scout-watch, not absorbed): LLM Guard (protectai, MIT) + NeMo Guardrails (NVIDIA-NeMo, Apache-2.0) - runtime LLM input/output GUARDRAILS (deploy-time control), out of the static audit-methodology lane and overlapping the wrong role; dims 9-10 (snyk/agent-scan + cisco) already cover STATIC agent-component review. Absorbed 2026-06-15, methodology-only.

ELITE 2026 audit-delivery depth pass (web research 2026-06-20: OASIS SARIF 2.1.0 + microsoft/sarif-sdk multitool merge; EPSS FIRST.org + CISA KEV; osv-scanner --call-analysis reachability; github/codeql LICENSE-FLAGGED free-for-OSS-only) - methodology-only, no code/queries/rule-packs bundled. Gate-0 vs scanning-stack.md (tool/check CATALOG, per-tool SARIF only) + trivy-and-dast.md (single-scanner run) + adversarial-bounty-hunting.md (attacker mindset on ONE finding) + audit-firm-methodology.md (post-finding LOOP on a CONFIRMED finding): NONE carried the multi-tool SARIF normalize+dedup+rank into one client risk register, the 7-dimension exploitability triage matrix that cuts the set before the client reads it, or the deep CodeQL nightly dataflow tier distinct from the fast Semgrep tier. NET-NEW references/elite-audit-delivery.md: (1) aggregated risk register (emit SARIF 2.1.0 from the whole catalog -> merge preserving provenance + vendor-diversity-as-supply-chain-control per FA-2 -> normalize onto rules.md taxonomy -> dedup with corroboratedBy confidence -> enrich EPSS/KEV/reachability/variant-class/custom-rule -> render machine SARIF + client-facing ranked register, per-finding write-ups via bounty report structure); (2) 7-dimension exploitability triage matrix (severity/EPSS/KEV/reachability/deployment-context/business-impact/fix-availability; reachability the highest-leverage cut 70-95%; P0/P1 vs P2 vs P3-accepted with owner+expiry; live secret always P0+rotate; KEV never pardoned by reachability; maps to SOC2/ISO/PCI evidence); (3) CodeQL deep-query tier (two-tier: Semgrep fast/diff-aware vs CodeQL nightly whole-program; test-first custom-QL as audit-firm rule discipline raised to QL; WE-authored QL = engagement work product separate from default suites). Explicit CodeQL LICENSE FLAG (OSS-only; GHAS for private -> CONNECT, fall back Semgrep Pro/manual). Cross-linked to code-reviewer sarif-aggregation-and-reachability-triage.md (PR-scale mirror). NO tool lists duplicated. NO em-dashes. Absorbed 2026-06-20, methodology-only.
